messages:
alex: Quick run of qprofile onboarding for marlin-70B across regions + GPUs. Goal: compare FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8 latency & throughput, and check QA accuracy delta on our 5k QA eval set. Pushed results to /mnt/bench/qprofiles/171112 — summary below, pls react if you want raw logs.
perf-bot: Automated summary: H100 eu-west-1 vs us-west-2, A100 eu-central vs us-east. Runs: seq_len=1024, batch=1..8, warmup=50, samples=200. Collected p50/p95, tokens/sec, and eval_acc (exact match) on qa5k.
perf-bot: CSV: /mnt/bench/qprofiles/171112/summary.csv, plots: https://internal.redwood/charts/qprofiles/171112 (open to eng-ml team) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: Quick highlights I saw:
- H100 (us): INT8 -> 2.6x tokens/sec vs FP16, eval_acc drop = -1.1pp (from 78.6% -> 77.5%). FP8 -> 3.0x, eval_acc drop = -2.7pp.
- A100 (eu): INT8 -> 1.9x, eval_acc drop = -0.8pp; FP8 -> 2.4x, eval_acc drop = -1.9pp.
Note: numbers are median across batches 1..4, fp16 baseline.

kevin: Nice. Do we have kernel choices recorded? e.g., fused-attn vs generic matmul? Those often drive H100 FP8 perf.

maria: Yep, recorded per-run. H100 FP8 used amp-fused attention + custom qkernel v2. INT8 used iq-tree kernels + per-channel scaling. A100 fell back to tiled GEMM for FP8 (less optimized) which explains part of delta.

sasha: Region delta: eu latency p95 was ~8% worse on FP8 for H100 compared to us, but tokens/sec similar. Suspect NUMA / instance packed placement in eu cluster — saw higher context-switches on those hosts. I can open infra ticket if we want consistent baselines.

alex: Thanks. Specific recommendations for a rollout plan? We need something conservative for Dedicated customers and more aggressive for Hosted.

maria: Proposal:
- Hosted (PLG): Enable INT8-by-default on H100/us for low-latency routes (route-level opt-in). Monitor eval_acc with a 1.5pp alert threshold. Auto-fallback to FP16 if regression.
- Dedicated/Enterprise: Make FP8 an opt-in experimental profile only after customer signs off (since avg drop ~2pp). Provide canned eval report and per-customer eval run.
- A100: prefer INT8 for now (better quality/perf tradeoff) until we land tiled GEMM FP8 kernel improvements.

kevin: Also add kernel routing rule: prefer qkernel-v2 for FP8 on h100, fallback to fp16 if kernel unavailable. We'll include canary rollout 5% traffic for first 48h.

sasha: I'm going to file infra ticket: INFRA-1129 to investigate eu node packing and reproduce high p95. Tagging @kevin and @alex for prioritization.

maria: Attached sample command we used (for reproducibility):
```
./run_profile.sh --model marlin-70b --seq 1024 --batches 1,2,4 --gpus H100,A100 --profiles fp16,bf16,int8,fp8 --eval qa5k --warmup 50 --out /mnt/bench/qprofiles/171112
```

alex: Perfect. Can someone drop raw eval csv in the thread when available? Also add a short note on how we computed eval_acc (exact match / normalization).

maria: Done — uploaded summary.csv and eval_details.csv. eval_acc = exact-match after simple whitespace/lowercase normalization; we included raw logits in eval_details for thresholding experiments.

perf-bot: Final note: recommend alert thresholds: eval_acc delta >= 1.5pp => rollback; token/sec improvement < 1.3x => don't enable for latency-critical routes.

alex: Great work team. We'll draft rollout playbook from these notes and sync on Wed. :thumbsup:
